The coordinates of points A and B must be within the range of -10000 to 10000.
The number of trenches n must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all((x1 == x2 or y1 == y2) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in trenches)
preconditions.description: Each trench must be either horizontal or vertical.
